## Summary

**Standardize the operator status card**

Primary words occupy entire panels without reason, impact or action.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-02`
- DUX code: `DUX5-11`

## Scope

Overview, Pipeline Diagnostics, Provider Health, Data Quality, Incident Workspace, Trust.

Screenshot groups: SG-02..SG-07 status-dominant boards

## Concrete change

Create a library card: Status badge, primary statement, reason, impact, action, freshness/source. Use neutral surface and colored strip/icon.

## Expected effect

Faster recognition and less color saturation.

## Acceptance criteria

- Each first-screen status has state + reason + action; supporting text remains visible; full-color backgrounds reserved for critical state.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Status semantics and shared library-panel governance.

## Risk

Over-standardization may reduce domain nuance; allow optional fields.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Implements first-screen status card pattern (state x reason x impact x action) as library panel.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
